result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by limiting the payment to early convenience termination during the initial term, using three months’ fees, and making it HDI’s sole and exclusive remedy. However, the set-off right and several detailed exceptions—particularly anniversary termination, Section 1.6, and change of control—go beyond what is necessary to implement the fallback. Unrelated commercial intent is generally preserved. Drafting quality is reduced by retaining the grammatically incomplete paragraph beginning “Payment is determined” and by leaving an eight-quarter payment schedule for an amount calculated by reference to only three months’ fees.
